metadata.case_name: CHAN SAI CHIU v. CHING YAN CHEUK T/A EDEN CONNECTIONS DESIGN & ENGINEERING CO

injuries.description: deep laceration of left index finger pulp.
source: deep laceration of left index finger pulp.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of finger or thumb

manifestations.description: persistent numbness and pain over his left index finger
pain, numbness, hypersensitive and stiffness at his left index finger
atrophy of the left index finger pulp
slight decrease in range of motion of the left index finger joints
mild decrease in grip strength but a significant decrease in pinch grip with left index finger

treatments_received.treatment: attendance at Accident & Emergency Department of Ruttonjee & Tang Shiu Kin Hospitals (TSKH) and conservative treatment
source: After the Accident, the plaintiff attended A&E of TSKH for medical treatment on 10 April 2009.
He was treated conservatively and discharged with sick leave.
He attended several follow-up treatments at TSKH and sick leave was granted up to 31 May 2009.

treatments_received.treatment: wound dressing at Shek Kip Mei General Out Patient Clinic
source: The plaintiff attended the Clinic several times for wound dressing.

Dr Lam recommended the plaintiff to undergo a course of occupational therapy with desensitization program. Dr Lam recommended a six weeks course of treatment with three sessions per week. He estimated that the cost was about $500 per session in private sector.

losses.description: general damages for pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from the deep laceration and residual symptoms of the left index finger

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Yun San v Cheung Yue Yiu trading as Radio Engineering Co
comparable_cases.injury_description: the claimant’s left index and middle fingers were injured in the accident by a circular saw. He was found to have sustained a crush injury to his left middle and index fingers. There was pulp loss in his left index finger and a deep laceration in the middle finger exposing extensor tendon over proximal interphalangeal joint. X-ray showed communited intra-articular fracture of the condyle of the proximal phalanx of the left middle finger. He had undergone two surgical operations.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Hung Hang v Fat Kee Marine Repairing & Engineering Co Limited and Anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: the claimant welder injured his right middle finger in the accident. He was found to have suffered crush injury to his right middle finger. Physical examination revealed bruise and tenderness over the tip of the right middle finger and subungal haematoma over nail. X-ray showed fracture of the tuft of distal phalanx of the right middle finger.
